spans.text: Inside Samo's neural cloud.
As usual, Samo finds her seat and takes it. The seven chairs around her are already filled.
This all feels familiar...
...That girl has memories concerning us.
Whose memories are they...
Could it be... After 13 years...
Can we finally tell which of us is whom now?
...Perhaps.
There are a total of seven stretches of memory concerning that girl.
Since we can't reveal our identity to the outside world and neither have we revealed anything to that girl...
The only thing that we can use to verify our identities is a section of memories of teaching others.
Teaching others?
One of us taught her how to disarm bombs... as well as shooting.
In that memory, I could see my gun from "my" perspective.
Who was it?
Eula.
A round of applause fills the air.
Congratulations on finding your memories.
Congratulations. Your name is now Eula.
...I'm Eula, then?
We've taken another step forward.
Yes, this is a huge improvement.
Yes, Eula. Congratulations on rediscovering your own name.
Bang, bang, bang—
The forceful knocking on the door awakens Samo from the depths of her neural cloud.
Don't worry, it's a delivery for me...
Cheryl opens the door and takes the package.
This is a capacitor I bought for you. I was going to install it into you today.
That way, your charge might last a little longer...
It's only secondhand, but I think it should be better than your current battery.
There's something I want to tell you.
What's wrong?
Samo walks over to Cheryl's side without saying a word and clears a space big enough to sit in from among the clothes.
On the 1st of December, 14 years ago...
The Doll who saved you was called Eula.
Eula...
Is that your real name?
Can I call you Big Sis Eula from now on?
...Please don't.
Why?
That's because... I can only confirm that the person who saved you was "Eula".
But I can't be sure that I am "Eula".
What are you talking about?
...13 years have passed, and I guess some things don't need to be secret anymore.
I used to be a soldier.
...I guessed as much. After all, that kidnapping case back then had a far-reaching impact, and I heard the military had to wrap things up in the end.
After we were sent home, our parents were told to keep quiet about it... I only managed to find some information much later on the internet, after I grew older.
Samo takes out a piece of paper and draws 8 little black stick figures, and then a special little red stick figure.
She then uses a red gel pen to cancel out seven of the black stick figures.
I belonged to a special forces unit, and our leader went rogue while we were carrying out a mission.
My other team members were wiped out by our leader, but the strange thing is... our memories are all mixed together and jammed into my neural cloud core.
And that's why... I'm not sure who I am.
But you gave us enough information to remember one person's identity.
For that, we are all very grateful.
Aw, don't mention it! All in a day's work! Big Sis Eula, I've always wanted to—
Therefore, we've decided to leave this place.
All of us have decided.
...Why?
Because 13 years ago, we watched our leader die, and we thought that it was the end of her.
But yesterday, we saw her again.
She's come back to life, and she has an even more powerful body than before.
Her name is Aliana.
So she was that rival of yours who forced you to dive into a dumpster?
Yeah...
But your memories don't just belong to one person. Perhaps you're not the one she's looking for, or perhaps you've gotten it all wrong...
It isn't time yet. We can still sort through your memories. Someday, you'll know who is who.
Cheryl sighs and places her warm palm on the back of Samo's hand.
Well, that's the problem.
I don't have that time...
W-What do you mean?
She's coming to kill me. Right now.
Cheryl clutches Samo's hand in fear. The red pen is just a millimeter away from crossing out that last black figure.
Then what should we do?
We?
Samo stands up indifferently.
I told you, this matter doesn't concern you. I'm leaving.
Wait, wait a minute...
How can this be none of my business. You're my Doll now, my personal property. Nobody can touch you without my permission.
Samo can't help but laugh as she looks at the girl gesticulating wildly in front of her, as though trying to fight off imaginary enemies with all her might.
...I appreciate your good intentions, but Aliana isn't the kind of person who'll stop just because you tell her to freeze.
Don't look down on me!
I've been preparing for this day ever since that incident from 14 years ago.
I saw your liquid nitrogen freeze gun already!
That's nothing! I've gotten my hands on a real firearm; I even have a proper gun license now!
Cheryl jumps up and rummages through the piles of junk around her.
In an instant, a smorgasbord of self-defense weapons ranging from spiked tetsubos to tasers and even pepper spray go flying through the room.
That's enough. You'll have to put it all back afterwards...
I've used them all before! They might look crude, but they really are useful!
Your gear might be able to damage a civilian Doll, but against a Tactical Doll...
You probably wouldn't be able to scratch one, especially if it was Aliana.
Is Aliana really that strong...
Cheryl, who is halfway through swinging one of her spiky tetsubos, instantly deflates.
Wow— How are you going to beat her, then?
...I haven't thought about that yet.
But I'm going to avenge them.
Cheryl places her hands on Samo's shoulders and forces the latter to sit back down.
You aren't going anywhere until you've figured it out!
Cheryl forcefully pokes her charging panel with her finger.
You see this charging panel? You're not leaving until it's full.
This is the most powerful secondhand capacitor I could find on the market.
You said you've got eight people in your neural cloud, right? No wonder you're gulping power...
I don't want to have to dig you out of a downstairs rubbish bin afterwards!
But your house circuits...
The moment they connect to the high-power capacitor, the pitiful residential apartment's circuit breakers promptly—
Snap. They trip.
...Ahhh, at most I'll just use a torchlight! I'll turn off all my electrical appliances; it's safer without the lights on anyway!
Haven't you seen spy movies before? The further you are from windows at times like this, the better.
That's it, then. If your team leader arrives, I'll—I'll be able to cover for you a little, at least!
Dolls can't shoot humans without permission!
Cheryl's apartment goes dark. Only the subdued flashing of the green charging panel indicates that this night is anything but ordinary.
